name: University Community Center
summary: The stepped University Community Centre features a largely blank west facade of warm vertically scored precast panels, a curved south plan, and an east plaza elevation with dark gridded glass between pale horizontal bands, a tall semicircular mirrored arch, and a rounded balcony above grouped red doors.

evidence.note: Sunlit west corner has nearly blind tan scored panels with horizontal construction joints.
Dark recessed opening interrupts the lower western blocks.
Plaza portal with round arch, shallow curved upper balcony and rectangular glazing on either side.
Cover shows mirrored radial soffit, red doors and glass balcony rail in the portal.
The south wall follows a broad arc on walls 10–16. The western box, glazed plaza wings and long raised rooflight have distinct roof edges.
Ground-relative P50 13.45 m, P90 15.6 m and maximum 17.82 m.
Wall colour sampled with PIL. KartaView 128912251 at normalized pixel (0.985, 0.586). Roof tone sampled from the 2025 orthophoto. Dimensions and bay counts on obscured elevations are estimates.
Western service block has tan precast. Plaza spandrels and the portal surround use separate colours sampled from the Western Facilities photograph. The semicircular recess spans the upper floors.

notes: The repetitive punched windows were replaced with isolated dark recessed service openings while the blank vertically scored concrete stretches were kept. The vaulted reflective soffit, curved balcony, and red door bank read as a small shallow opening from the southeast.
